name: orchestrator
description: Orchestrate multiple AI coding agent sessions simultaneously

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
scripts.test:providers: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out-test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --outDir out-test --module commonjs && node --test out-test/src/main/__tests__/*.test.js
scripts.smoke:providers: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --outDir out-test --module commonjs && node scripts/provider-diagnostics.mjs
scripts.live:providers: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --outDir out-test --module commonjs && node scripts/provider-live-smoke.mjs
scripts.live:codex-browser-appserver: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out-test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --outDir out-test --module commonjs && node scripts/codex-browser-appserver-live-proof.mjs
scripts.live:codex-dynamic-tools: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out-test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --outDir out-test --module commonjs && CODEX_BROWSER_PROOF_DYNAMIC_TOOL=1 CODEX_BROWSER_PROOF_ARTIFACT_DIR=tmp/codex-dynamic-tools-live-proof node scripts/codex-browser-appserver-live-proof.mjs
scripts.live:codex-browser-tools: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out-test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --outDir out-test --module commonjs && CODEX_BROWSER_PROOF_REAL_BROWSER_TOOLS=1 CODEX_BROWSER_PROOF_ARTIFACT_DIR=tmp/codex-browser-tools-live-proof node scripts/codex-browser-appserver-live-proof.mjs
scripts.live:codex-composer-appserver: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out-test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --outDir out-test --module commonjs && node scripts/codex-composer-appserver-live-proof.mjs
scripts.live:codex-composer-approval: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out-test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --outDir out-test --module commonjs && CODEX_COMPOSER_PROOF_REQUIRE_APPROVAL=1 CODEX_COMPOSER_PROOF_ARTIFACT_DIR=tmp/codex-composer-approval-live-proof node scripts/codex-composer-appserver-live-proof.mjs
scripts.live:codex-review-appserver: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out-test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --outDir out-test --module commonjs && node scripts/codex-review-appserver-live-proof.mjs
scripts.live:claude-capabilities: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --outDir out-test --module commonjs && node scripts/claude-live-capability-suite.mjs
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Run npm run rebuild to build native modules'
scripts.live:codex-pinned-threads: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out-test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --outDir out-test --module commonjs && node scripts/codex-pinned-threads-live-proof.mjs
